hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Dakpakha [dka] (in Bhutan, E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29), Takpa [tkk] (in China) and Tawang Monpa [twm] (in China and India, E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29) are the same language but named differently by their respective country authorities (**hh:hev:Bodt:Eastern-Bhutan**:273-276,
**hh:s:HyslopTshering:Dakpa**, **hh:hew:Grewal:Arunachal**,
**hh:hvwphon:Sun:Zang-Mian-Yuyin-Cihui**). See also: Dakpakha [dka].

endangerment.comment: Takpa (5626-twm) = Threatened (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [van Driem 2007](cldf:driem:07)
